description: Given a filmmaking brief, return the closest intent-routed MCP recommendations: one compact pick per primary server (slug, role, why, remote, official, verified) plus compact fallbacks. Use hosted_only=true when the agent cannot spawn local tools; get_film_mcp for full server detail.

brief.description: What you're trying to make, e.g. 'avatar UGC ad with voiceover' or 'search dailies and cut a trailer'

constraints.description: Hard constraints applied before relevance. Also inferred from the brief ('locally', 'without uploading', 'confidential', 'offline', 'no budget', 'free', 'no local install'). Picks that violate one are excluded; if nothing survives, unsatisfied_constraints explains why.

has_shell.description: false means the agent cannot run local processes; implies hosted_only.

local_only.description: Only servers with a local install path (stdio or local app).

no_upload.description: Only local servers with no cloud credential, so media never leaves the machine.

os.description: macos | windows | linux; excludes listings that say they only run elsewhere.

hosted_only.description: Only return hosted remote primary/fallback servers where possible.

include_inactive.description: Also consider servers whose status is dead, archived or deprecated. Default false.

verbosity.description: compact (default): one small object per pick in primary/primary_servers and fallback_servers. full: the complete server objects, as before.

name: recommend_film_mcps
title: Recommend MCP servers for a brief
